description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and constants related to User Equipment (UE) management in the MAC layer of a radio communication system, including creation, reconfiguration, deletion, and notification of radio link failures.

classes.name: mac_ue_radio_link_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying radio link failures and C-RNTI change events for a UE.

classes.name: mac_logical_channel_config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a logical channel associated with a UE.

classes.name: mac_ue_create_request
classes.description: Parameters required to create a UE in the MAC layer.

classes.name: mac_ue_create_response
classes.description: Result of a UE creation request, including assigned identifiers.

classes.name: mac_ue_reconfiguration_request
classes.description: Parameters to reconfigure an existing UE.

classes.name: mac_ue_reconfiguration_response
classes.description: Outcome of a UE reconfiguration request.

classes.name: mac_ue_delete_request
classes.description: Parameters to delete a UE from MAC.

classes.name: mac_ue_delete_response
classes.description: Result of a UE deletion request.

classes.name: mac_ue_configurator
classes.description: Interface for managing UE lifecycle in MAC (create, reconfigure, delete).

methods.name: handle_ue_create_request
methods.description: Asynchronously handles a request to create a UE.

methods.name: handle_ue_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Asynchronously handles a request to reconfigure a UE.

methods.name: handle_ue_delete_request
methods.description: Asynchronously handles a request to delete a UE.

methods.name: handle_ul_ccch_msg
methods.description: Forwards UL-CCCH message to upper layers.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Confirms that the UE received the last RRC configuration.
